verdict.rationale: Brevo's pricing page documents A/B testing of subject lines or content variants aimed at improving opens and clicks. That covers the testing half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows the winner being picked automatically from real engagement, or how the test is configured. Missing for 10: documented automatic winner selection based on opens/clicks, details on test configuration (split size, test duration, winning criteria), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can A/B test subject lines or content variants and have the winner picked from real engagement

citations.quote: Test subject lines or content variants to improve opens and clicks.
